response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id AS order_item_id, p.product_color AS product_color, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color), r AS (SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY CASE WHEN avg_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, avg_quantity DESC) AS rnk FROM g) SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, rnk FROM r WHERE rnk <= 3

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity (VARCHAR) is cast to a number for averaging; non-numeric strings are assumed absent.
A derived_total_cost of 0 gives a NULL ratio (via NULLIF), which is ignored in the average rather than raising a division error.
Products with NULL color form their own group and their own ranking partition.
The ratio is computed per line item, then averaged.
